description: This file implements serialization and deserialization of transport security state data, including handling of JSON format, base64 encoding, and file I/O for persisting security policies related to HTTP transport security.

classes.name: TransportSecurityPersister
classes.description: Handles persistence of transport security state data, including serialization to and from JSON, file I/O, and managing state updates.

methods.name: TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persister with security state, background task runner, and data file path.

methods.name: ~TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up pending writes and removing delegate.

methods.name: StateIsDirty
methods.description: Marks the security state as dirty, scheduling a write.

methods.name: WriteNow
methods.description: Immediately writes the current state to disk, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes the security state into a JSON string.

methods.name: LoadEntries
methods.description: Loads and deserializes state data from a string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses JSON string and updates security state, handling versioning and legacy data.

methods.name: CompleteLoad
methods.description: Completes loading process after reading data from disk.
